# Role and permission matrix

Defined in `backend/app/core/rbac.py` and enforced per endpoint (see the *Access* column of the
[API reference](../api/README.md)). Users also carry region scopes (`IN`, `UAE`); every query is
filtered to them, and records with an unknown region are visible only to users scoped to both.

| Permission | agent_l1 | agent_l2 | engineer_l3 | support_lead | kb_owner | dpo | finance_viewer | admin |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `audit:read` |  |  |  | yes |  | yes |  | yes |
| `users:manage` |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | yes |
| `tickets:read` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |  | yes |
| `customers:read` | yes | yes | yes | yes |  |  | yes | yes |
| `sla:read` |  |  |  | yes |  |  | yes | yes |
| `ingestion:run` |  |  |  | yes |  |  |  | yes |
| `ingestion:read` |  |  |  | yes |  | yes |  | yes |
| `knowledge:read` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |  |  | yes |
| `knowledge:manage` |  |  |  |  | yes |  |  | yes |
| `incidents:manage` |  |  |  | yes |  |  |  | yes |
| `tickets:process` |  | yes |  | yes |  |  |  | yes |
| `approvals:read` | yes | yes | yes | yes |  |  |  | yes |
| `approvals:edit` | yes | yes | yes | yes |  |  |  | yes |
| `approvals:decide` |  | yes |  | yes |  |  |  | yes |
| `pii:reveal` |  |  |  |  |  | yes |  |  |
| `settings:read` |  |  |  | yes |  |  |  | yes |
| `settings:manage` |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | yes |
| `evaluations:read` |  |  |  | yes |  | yes | yes | yes |
| `evaluations:run` |  |  |  | yes |  |  |  | yes |

`pii:reveal` belongs to the DPO alone; admins are deliberately excluded. Approving a draft for routing rules R6/R7 additionally requires a second person (the last editor cannot approve).
